notes.title: Lost Rift Demo Is Live!
notes.content:
[h2]Play the Lost Rift Demo for FREE [b]September 17-24[/b]! [/h2][h3]This is your chance to get a taste of the core gameplay loop before the full game launches on September 25, 2025.[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="7Sq0dV-Sb-Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In the demo, you'll start your journey on Pioneers’ Landing, where you'll be introduced to Wade, a character who will help you get established and guide you toward your first Expedition on Western Island. This is where you'll experience the intense extraction shooter gameplay that's at the heart of Lost Rift.[/p][p]Back on Pioneers’ Landing, you’ll see the ever-present anomaly wall, which will restrict your access to the starting area for the duration of the demo. The wall will finally come down on launch day, September 25.  [/p][p]Please read on below to see all of the new features and significant changes that we’ve made to the demo since our last public playtest.[/p][p][i]Demo Notice: Any progress you make during the demo, including your character and island progress, will not transfer to the launch version of the game. All data will be wiped before the official launch.[/i][/p][p]Let us know what you think on our social channels, and be sure to add us to your Steam Wishlist.[/p][p][/p][h3]No Host Needed: Shared Islands[/h3][p]We've made it easier than ever to play together. [b]You and your squadmates can now access[/b] [b]any Shared Island at any time[/b], without needing the player who created the island to be online. Any player with access can launch the island whenever they want. The person who initially creates the Shared Island can send a more secure one-time invite code to each friend, which provides access to the island. Our new invite codes also help prevent unwanted guests from showing up and causing trouble.
[/p][h3]Visually Updated Building System[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/73a20cedf6e6cfc8082f0a75d6a9ec936ef8a86d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The building in Lost Rift has undergone significant visual upgrades since our last playtest. The thatch building set has been completely visually overhauled and now includes the following pieces:  [/p][list][*][p]Thatch Floor Tile (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Thatch Triangle Floor Tile (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Thatch Wall Tile (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Thatch Wall Triangle (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Thatch Inverted Wall Triangle (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Thatch Angled Roof (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Thatch Angled Tile (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Wood Vertical Beam (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Wood Horizontal Beam (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Wood Diagonal Beam (5x, 3x, 1x)[/p][/*][*][p]Thatch Door[/p][/*][/list][p]We look forward to seeing what players can create with all of these options.[/p][p]Many of the functional and decorative items that can be placed in your base camp have also received visual updates. We will leave these for you to explore![/p][h3]Get Comfy![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/41d60777723d93191585085dea4c8fc66c2a312f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Tired of a boring, lifeless base? Now you can jazz it up with some decorations and get a bonus while you're at it! Decorating your base camp with furniture and other fun items now gives you a [i]Comfort Buff[/i]. The more you decorate, the stronger the buff gets.[/p][list][*][p]Check your Camp Comfort Level at the Survivor Beacon[/p][/*][*][p]Each decoration gives you comfort points (1-10 points per item)[/p][/*][*][p]Some items, like plants, can be placed multiple times for more points (up to 5 of the same type)[/p][/*][*][p]Other items, like a bed, only give you points for the first one you place[/p][/*][/list][p]Your goal is to reach a Camp Comfort Rank of 10 by getting 1000 points. At this max rank, you'll get a big bonus: a +50 stamina buff that lasts for 20 minutes and is refreshed by sleeping at the camp. Your Comfort Buff will also persist when travelling to Expedition, to get the edge over your opponents![/p][p][/p][h3]Progression Updates[/h3][p]If you have played in multiple playtests, you’ll know that early-game progression is something we have been hammering away on to perfect it. We have been focused on helping new players become more established at camp and better prepared for the battles ahead on Expedition. 
[/p][p]Many changes have been made to streamline the gameplay flow, including adjustments to the amount of resources picked up and harvested, crafting recipe requirements, and the process of unlocking different recipes. 
[/p][h3]Visual Upgrades[/h3][p]Lost Rift continues to look better than ever as new game art floods the islands. You’ll notice visual changes to foliage, upgrades to POIs on the Western Island, as well as art updates to consumables, decorative items, workbenches, and more. [/p][p][/p][h3]No Infinite Revives: Heavy Wound System[/h3][p]When you are downed, you will now receive a debuff called [i]Heavy Wound[/i]. This debuff will start a timer during which you will not be able to be revived again. The debuff will prevent squads from repeatedly reviving each other during active PVP altercations. [/p][p][/p][h3]Expedition Rejoin[/h3][p]If you get disconnected from an Expedition due to a server error or a crash, you'll now be able to rejoin your previous mission right away from the main menu. This means your progress, loot, and inventory will be safe. You can jump right back into the action without losing anything![/p][p][/p][h3]Enemy AI Improvements[/h3][p]We've been hard at work polishing the enemy AI and combat, making every encounter more challenging and fun. This includes everyone's favorite enemy, Bonkey. We've also made a significant change to how enemies spawn. Now, the number of enemies you face will scale to the number of players in your squad. Whether you're playing solo or with a full squad, you'll encounter a fair but challenging number of hyenas and Outcasts on your Island and during Expeditions.
[/p][p]Finally, we've fixed many navigation bugs that were causing enemies to act dumber than intended. They'll now move more intelligently, so be prepared![/p][p][/p][h3]Additional Changes[/h3][list][*][p]You can now spectate your teammates on Expedition upon your death.[/p][/*][*][p]We are now enforcing a character limit and an Island limit. Each player can create up to three characters and three islands. However, there is no limit on how many of your friends' islands you can join.[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve added [i]Transfer Item Stacks[/i] and[i] Loot All [/i]buttons in the inventory screen, allowing you to optimize your backpack and empty loot faster into chests after Expeditions. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved gamepad support, especially in Big Picture mode[/p][/*][*][p]Dodos now eat berries![/p][/*][/list][h3]If you enjoy the demo, be sure to wishlist us on Steam and come back on September 25 for the Early Access release![/h3]

notes.title: Lost Rift Coming to Early Access September 25!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ElGXodS-Y6k;full][/previewyoutube]
Get ready to wash ashore on the mysterious archipelago of [i]Lost Rift[/i]. Lost Rift will be launching into Steam Early Access on [b]September 25, 2025 for $24.99 USD[/b], with a limited-time [b]20% launch discount![/b]

[b]Lost Rift is a first-person survival shooter combining base-building, cooperative PvE, and intense PvPvE gameplay. Set in a mysterious archipelago, players wash up on the island of Pioneers’ Landing to begin their journey to survive, explore, conquer, and progress.[/b]

The Early Access experience features new and exciting major game updates, including: 

[h3]10+ Hours of New PvE Narrative Gameplay[/h3]
Venture beyond the safety of the shores into narrative quests, enemies, and secrets to uncover as you explore the island with your friends. With several unique survivors to recruit, your quest will uncover the mysteries behind each new area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/0a17a092aec3a703c8d57732d7224c7c71e1961b.jpg[/img]
[h3]Solo & Co-Op PvE Survival[/h3]
Brave the archipelago solo or team up with up to four friends. Gather resources, craft weapons and armor, and take on hostile PvE enemies across dangerous landscapes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/c5e69cf569d4763696591145aac76a2541ea8b3e.png[/img]
[h3]PvPvE Multiplayer Combat Expeditionss[/h3]
Risk it all in multiplayer combat expeditions. Rally your team to secure rare loot and extract alive, or lose it all to rival players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/ef56c52581bd09e5507b6ddc13aad768467883df.jpg[/img]
[h3]Survival Sandbox & Base Building[/h3]
Utilize a unique tile-based shelter building system to craft, repair, and upgrade your ultimate base camp. Build the perfect hideout to keep your squad alive and prepare for what’s ahead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e56ef3e9fef45c28601aeadf85de6348e6177558.jpg[/img]
[h3]A World to Explore[/h3]
From dense jungles and sunny beaches to forgotten outposts and storm-lashed stations, each biome offers unique challenges, rewards, and threats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/aa452df8781c6caaec8ea22c69f73480d2c763e1.jpg[/img]
[h3]A Note on Early Access[/h3]
The focus at launch is on delivering the core survival experience. Some final art and polish (such as greybox placeholders) will be updated in future milestones as we expand and evolve the game with the community’s feedback.

We’re incredibly grateful for the support we've received from the community, and we can’t wait to share all the major content updates we have planned once the game goes live! Please stay tuned for our Public Roadmap, which we will be sharing closer to launch time.

notes.title: Join the Lost Rift Playtest Today!
notes.content:
We are live with our next public stress test for Lost Rift, and we need your help! Jump in to explore our latest updates, push our systems to their limits, and help us shape the future of the game as we head towards Early Access.

[h2]STRESS TEST DATES[/h2]
[list][*] August 7 at 1:30pm EDT until August 11 at 10am EDT
[*] Free and open to all via a 'Join the Playtest' button on our Steam Page; no sign-up or keys required![/list]

[h2]ACCESS[/h2]
[h3]In your Steam store, head over to our Steam page and click on the 'Join the Playtest' button in order to get access.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/27d2736fed6e680e09e4f9e45fd461f41a74d1b2.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494520/Lost_Rift/
[h2]PLAY TO UNLOCK NEW LORE[/h2]
Participating in this test will unlock the backstory of a mysterious new character… Get ready to meet Wade’s nemesis: [REDACTED].

As a challenge for our community, once we hit over [b]1000 Expedition Extractions[/b], we will [b]unlock [REDACTED]’s biography[/b]. You’ll unlock their name, their backstory, and how you’ll interact with them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/7163c5b0b3a26bb4197a0388a05b69b86dc47462.jpg[/img]

[h2]WHAT’S PLAYABLE IN THIS TEST[/h2]
You'll have access to a focused slice of our early game on [b]Pioneers’ Landing (PvE)[/b] and all of [b]Western Island Expedition (PvPvE)[/b] to explore. Exploration beyond the anomaly wall on Pioneers’ Landing is restricted while we continue tuning the game’s core progression. 

[h2]KEY FEATURES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
Thanks to all your feedback on our previous playtests and demo, we have made some serious progress across the board. Here's what changes are waiting for you.

[h3]Matchmaking[/h3]
[list][*] Matchmaking now better matches players within their same regions (this is loosened if the wait for a match takes too long)
[*] Improved matchmaking logic for PvP servers to be created in the most optimal region for all of the players in the match
[*] PvP matches now group players more fairly based on party size[/list]
[h3]Environment Art[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/eb63fdeabeb9ab8d56c360dfa8ae2dc8efa35c51.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Significant visual improvements across maps
[*] Updated Points of Interest on Western Island Expedition: Weather Station, Harbor, and Lighthouse[/list]
[h3]Building[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/35d94ba29a66eccc0b6a3365e4b3f2ea53882c37.jpg[/img]
[list][*] New diagonal pillars, triangle walls, and triangle floor pieces[/list]
[h3]User Experience[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/6abb9f9b726ab228c9006675b5b3b8f2010924a3.gif[/img]
[list][*] Expanded character creator options, including new hairstyles, body types, and clothing
[*] Improved onboarding for new players[/list]
[h3]Combat[/h3]
[list][*] Improved gunplay and overall balance
[*] Enhanced AI behavior for Hyenas and Outcasts
[*] Your base now has a chance to be raided by hyenas and Outcasts. Defeat the hostile invaders and complete the associated Side Quest (Hyena Problem or Jungle Outcasts, hit J to open your Journal)[/list]
[h3]Progression[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e5bcdfa6ea0b77fc4d6ba94fc207dac257e4ebf2.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Reworked side quests from Wade with new objectives and rewards
[*] Updated Expedition UI and Journal interface for clearer mission flow and quest tracking[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/1b66554354b5005b1014bbabbbe629442b4cea2c.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Machine-translated localization available for all supported languages
[*] Please note: translation inaccuracies may be present
[*] Official translations are planned for Early Access launch[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes & Stability[/h3]
[list][*] Multiple crash fixes
[*] Ongoing bug resolution across systems[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES FOR THIS PLAYTEST[/h2]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3494520/discussions/3/601911983259932105]Please see this forum post on the Discussions page for a list of Known Issues.[/url]

[h2]TELL US WHAT YOU THINK![/h2]
Our community is our compass guiding this expedition. Throughout this playtest, we will be active and listening to your feedback on all our social channels. Join the conversation and let us know what’s working, what isn’t, and what you want to see next.
[list][*] Steam Forums
[*]  [url="https://lostrift.com/discord"]Discord[/url]: #feedback-for-devs & #bug-reports
[*] Reddit: [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/LostRiftGame"]r/LostRiftGame[/url]
[*] Twitch & YouTube: tag us, stream it, post it, we’ll be watching![/list]
Every test makes Lost Rift stronger, and we can’t do it without you. We appreciate you fitting this playtest into your busy schedules.

To be the first to hear all our news, join our growing [url="https://lostrift.com/discord"]Discord Community[/url]:

[url="https://lostrift.com/discord"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/3628aa5e97b05ac5140de3c201d8e8d361feb075.png"][/img][/url]

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494520/Lost_Rift/"]Wishlist and Follow[/url] on Steam:

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3494520/Lost_Rift/"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/ac4017184ce55fc5fabf4ff73408574c8a509e3f.png"][/img][/url]

notes.title: Lost Rift Stress Playtest August 7!
notes.content:
[p]Rifters, your next opportunity to play Lost Rift is this week!

The final countdown has begun. This [b]Thursday August 7, at 10am EDT[/b], we’re hosting our next public stress playtest!

We’ve made changes and improvements across the board since you last saw us. We’re excited to have you back in the game to see what we’ve been working on behind the scenes. Heads up, this playtest will not cover all of the new features we’ve been making progress on, but rather focus on refining our key systems and ensuring both server performance and stability. Read on to hear about what you can expect from this test!

[/p][h2]UPGRADES & IMPROVEMENTS[/h2][p] More Character Creator options[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/6abb9f9b726ab228c9006675b5b3b8f2010924a3.gif"][/img] Fairer PvP matchmaking, especially for solo and duo players
 Updated AI for hyenas and Outcasts
 Crash fixes to improve stability (with more to come)
 Machine-translated localization (official translations coming for Early Access)
 Updated Expedition UI for clearer mission flow
 New Journal interface to better track your quest objectives[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e5bcdfa6ea0b77fc4d6ba94fc207dac257e4ebf2.jpg"][/img] Reworked side quests from Wade with new objectives and rewards
 Improved gunplay and balance
 Bug fixes: many squashed, more being hunted as we speak[/p][p][/p][h2]EXPLORE UPDATES POINTS OF INTEREST[/h2][p]Grey boxes are being smashed left, right, and center! [/p][p]Explore new sights to see and new dangers to brave on Expedition: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/5a1c3cd03db33a5a19a892888f90ea4099136e09.gif"][/img] [/p][p]Jump in this Thursday to see our third updated POI! Whether you're looting alone or surviving with friends, these updated and polished locations will bring more tactical depth and lore to uncover. The total playable area you’ll have access to will remain the same, featuring Pioneers’ Landing (PvE) and Expedition (PvPvE), as well as the same mysterious boundary that limits progression beyond the anomaly’s edge. The wall has been placed to help us hone in on the early-game experience. [/p][p] [/p][h2]PARTICIPATE IN THE STRESS TEST[/h2][p]August 7 at 10am EDT until August 11 at 10am EDT. [/p][p]Free and open to all via a 'Join the Playtest' button on our Steam Page; no sign-up or keys required![/p][p][/p][h2]SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK[/h2][p]We’re building Lost Rift with the help of our community, and your voice directly shapes its evolution. We are listening to your feedback across all our social channels, including:
 Steam forums & reviews
 [url="https://lostrift.com/discord"]Discord[/url] (#feedback-for-devs and #bug-reports channels)
 Reddit: [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/LostRiftGame"]r/LostRiftGame[/url]
 Twitch & YouTube contentFollow and wishlist Lost Rift on Steam to get notified when Early Access arrives.

We will see you in Pioneers’ Landing August 7!

[b]To be the first to hear all our news, join our growing [url="https://lostrift.com/discord"]Discord Community[/url]:[/b]

notes.title: Play Lost Rift Stress Test August 7th!
notes.content:
Rifters, your next opportunity to play Lost Rift is only two weeks away!

On [b]August 7 at 10am EDT[/b], we’ll be live with our next public stress playtest. Whether you're a returning castaway or if this will be your first playing Lost Rift, this is your chance to jump in and help us shape the game’s future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/ad2998727e33997860131007ae02d736241ff2c5.gif[/img]
[i]Playable Zone: Weather Station (on Expedition)[/i]

[h2][b]WHAT WE’VE ADDRESSED FROM YOUR FEEDBACK[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Better onboarding experience for new players (no more confusion over Tree Sap or Volcanic Rock)
[*] More fair PVP matchmaking for solo and duos
[*] Better balance for AI enemies
[*] Multiple crash fixes (though some may remain)
[*] Basic localization support added[/list]
[h2][b]WHAT’S IN THIS STRESS TEST[/b][/h2]
This playtest is focused on server stress-testing and system improvements, including:
[list][*] [b]Environment Art Progress:[/b] far fewer grey boxes and some truly stunning environment upgrades will be present, including the Weather Station (see gif)
[*] [b]Matchmaking Upgrades:[/b] PVP Expedition will now group players more fairly based on party size
[*] [b]Core System Updates:[/b] improved gunplay and overall balance
[*] [b]Side Quest Improvements:[/b] reworked side quests given by Wade, to give players access to new and cool objectives
[*] [b]Machine-translated Language Support:[/b] we are still working with a localization partner to have official translations for day 1 of Early Access 
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] and lots of them!][/list]
The playable area you’ll have access to will remain the same, with both Pioneers’ Landing (PvE) and Expedition (PvPvE) being available just as it was in our previous Steam Next Fest demo. You’ll encounter familiar ground and the same mysterious wall that blocks further exploration. This will allow us to refine the early game experience without distractions beyond the anomaly perimeter.

[list][*] August 7 at 10am EDT until August 11 at 10am EDT
[*] Free and open to all via Steam; no sign-up or keys required!
[/list]
If you’ve already followed and wishlisted us on Steam, you’ll be notified the moment the test goes live!

Your feedback has already helped us make major strides during the development of Lost Rift. Now we need your help again to push Lost Rift even further.

Be sure to wishlist Lost Rift on Steam to stay in the loop and get notified when Early Access launches.

We will see you in Pioneers’ Landing very soon!

notes.title: Lost Rift Test is coming back August 7th!
notes.content:
Hey Rifters! We’re excited to share that the next public playtest will be kicking off [b]August 7 at 10am EDT.[/b]

This is a major milestone for the team as we continue working hard towards Early Access release. We can’t wait to open the rift once more and invite you back to Pioneers’ Landing.

[h2][b]PUBLIC STRESS TEST[/b][/h2]
We are announcing this public stress test well in advance to give all players who wish to participate the opportunity to do so. 

[b]This open beta test is all about:[/b]   
[list][*] Stress-testing our servers and matchmaking improvements  
[*] PvP games will now prefer to match players into groups of similar size
[*] Gathering critical feedback on system improvements, such as [b]updated gun combat[/b]  
[*] Identifying bugs and issues across a broader player base  
[*] Seeing how YOU play so we can continue fine-tuning the player experience  
[*] [i]We will be implementing machine-translated text for all supported languages to test the localization system itself, so the text may not always be accurate. We are still working with a localization partner to have official translations for day 1 of Early Access.[/i][/list]

[list][*]  [b]Date and time: [/b]August 7 at 10am EDT until August 11 at 10am EDT

If you’ve already followed and wishlisted us on Steam, you’ll be notified the moment the test goes live!

We’ve been building Lost Rift with the core belief that player feedback makes our game stronger, which is why we value your participation in our playtests. Your voice helps shape the direction of the game, and tests like this one are our way of checking that we’re continuing on the right track.

During the playtest period, we’ll be actively monitoring:
[list][*] Steam forums
[*] Discord feedback channel
[*] Discord and Steam forum bug reports

[*] We are also launching our brand new subreddit, [url="https://www.reddit.com/r/LostRiftGame/"]r/LostRiftGame[/url]! If you prefer to use Reddit, join our page and post your playtest hype there, too! [/list]

notes.title: Thanks for playing in our Alpha Playtest
notes.content:
[h2]Playtest is now over - Servers are Offline[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/d6e2b258681638e722047a27c1b50e41e1c78956.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey Rifters,[/b]

Wow, that was one hell of a weekend! Thanks to everyone for your support, comments, questions, and feedback. With your efforts, we could test at a scale we could never have done internally! We had almost 10,000 unique players throughout our weekend, and most of you came in on Saturday and Sunday, where we just kept picking up steam (no pun intended)!

After our Thursday data, we identified a few key weak points and came in fast with our first ever hotfix, reducing the amount of crashes by about 25% for Saturday and Sunday. Not only that, but we were able to hot drop new quests, add a new way to find Resin (because a lot of you asked us about it on Discord), as well as several fixes for key pain points of our players.

So, to those of you who came to play our Alpha Playtest, thank you so much for helping us identify the issues we could've discovered only with your help. We'll be digging through the 100+ bugs/crashes/feedback/improvements we've uncovered through our backend, Discord reports, and several dedicated community members passing feedback on privately.

Thanks to all of you, we now have a clearer picture of what we need to fix for Lost Rift to offer the experience we're aiming for.

If you've read this far and haven't done so yet, we'd love for you to complete our quick [url=https://lostrift.com/playtestsurvey]Google Form survey[/url] and let us know your thoughts.

notes.title: Announcing the Lost Rift Steam Playtest
notes.content:
With Lost Rift formally announced and set to launch later this year, it's a good topic to start with: what Early Access means for Lost Rift.

While Early Access is becoming increasingly common in games, the definition of what Early Access is intended to look like varies significantly across different games, platforms, and genres.

We plan to be fully transparent about what we intend to deliver with your purchase of Lost Rift on Day 1, as well as what will be added later in Early Access development.

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]

To answer this question as simply as possible, we believe that now is the ideal time to gather community feedback on what we should focus on next. The core gameplay loop has come together well, and there is sufficient content to showcase our vision for the game. 

We believe we’re creating a great game, and we think it can only be improved with your feedback. So, without further delay, below you’ll find exactly what we intend to bring to Early Access, as well as what will be coming in the future. 

[b]What Comes with Early Access?[/b]

The base game and access to all future non-DLC updates, initially up to 5 characters, and 5 PvE island instances saved on our dedicated servers, with no limit on how many of your friends’ islands you join.

We plan to deliver both a PvE island (also known as Pioneers’ Landing) where you can spend hours exploring and building your survival space, along with a high-risk, high-reward PvPvE extraction experience where rare and exotic loot can be obtained that will help you progress your quests when you return.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/63f466a6bcb909c117df384aa43c1b3c87e39f6c.jpg[/img]

[h2]What We Plan to Bring Early Access on Day 1[/h2]

The Lost Rift team is striving to bring you three key things on Early Access launch day:

[b]1. A Strong Core Gameplay Loop & Body of Content[/b]

We’re applying People Can Fly’s expertise in gunplay and fusing PvE survival and PvPvE extraction into a unique, replayable, ever-evolving experience. We want to generate an experience that incites wonder and curiosity as you begin to explore Pioneers' Landing, our PvE-only island. You can explore, build, hunt, cook, and craft alongside with up to four friends, or as a solo adventurer. You can uncover new areas at your own pace, stock up on supplies, complete quests, and recruit NPC Survivors to help protect your base camp. 

In juxtaposition to the relative safety of the PvE survival island, we also plan to have the first fully explorable Expedition island, a time-pressured and intense PvPvE experience filled with stronger PvE threats and, more importantly, rare loot that you can’t craft back at Pioneers' Landing. You may run into other matchmade players, where you will have to decide whether to engage or stick to the shadows and loot the scraps of bigger teams.

You’ll find a variety of enemies on Expeditions, including Outcasts (our name for the humanoid enemies), predators both big and small, prey, other real players, and more as you try to locate the wires, screwdrivers, and other special loot required to progress the initial story. If you die on an Expedition, you’ll lose everything you had with you and return to Pioneers' Landing. If you successfully extract, you’ll retain everything you found and be one step closer to accessing new areas or quests.

We want to demonstrate how we can seamlessly blend these two experiences, all while incorporating satisfying gunplay that delivers strong, moment-to-moment gameplay.

[b]2. Stable Experience[/b]
We want to ensure that you have a stable and friction-free experience. Our team has collaborated for months to do everything possible to quickly mitigate any issues with connecting to servers and provide a stable experience, allowing you to focus on giving us gameplay feedback instead of troubleshooting.

While we can’t promise everything will be perfect, this is early access for a reason, after all. We’re becoming increasingly confident, having conducted internal company-wide tests, and will be rolling it out to a much larger scale with Steam Playtest on May 15th.

[b]3. Transparency & Open Communication[/b]

We announced in mid-March and launched our [url=https://lostrift.com/discord]Discord server[/url], with most of our development team as active participants, who can be identified by their handles, which start with 'PCF_'. We aim to be transparent about our goals and what we intend to deliver during Early Access, allowing you to see more of the work in progress through quick screengrabs, GIFs, and playtest blooper videos.

Once players get their hands on the game, we will listen to your feedback. Whether you think something is too powerful, too weak, too long, or too short, we genuinely want to know about it, and we believe our team can deliver an even better game with your collaboration and contributions. 

[b]What we [u][i]won’t[/i][/u] have on Day 1 of Early Access[/b]

With transparency in mind, all of the below are goals we’ll be working towards over the course of Early Access, but won’t be fully realized on launch day. 

[b]We [i][u]won’t[/u][/i] have the final art & assets[/b]
Our small team of artists has been hard at work delivering a wealth of outfits, jungle biomes, weapons, building pieces, and more. That said, the game will be far from ‘art complete’ on Day 1 of Early Access.

This means that you will encounter missing textures, placeholder assets, and greybox in our game. Gameplay is king, and incomplete art should not prevent us from sharing our plans or delaying our playtests, allowing you to play and provide your feedback. 

Here is one easy example of art in our game and what “Placeholder” or “Greybox” means. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549107/e2778a8c18c988d93141e0ce9287704acfd2dd27.jpg[/img]

The above screenshot is a great example. From a distance, you can tell what the Antenna is, and it has a rough shape. However, it lacks textures and artistic refinement to make it look like an actual building. It’s there, it’s functional for gameplay, but it's far from the quality we’re striving for in our 1.0 game launch. Many of our assets are currently in this state, and we have a priority list of improvements for 2025. 

[b]We [u][i]won’t[/i][/u] have a bug-free experience[/b]
You can have the biggest and best QA team in the world, and players will find more weird and wonderful issues on day one than the QA team finds in a year.

As a result, we’ve been working diligently to organize ourselves to streamline our reporting and bug-fixing process. We’re ready to listen, diagnose, and patch starting from day one. When you experience an issue, hit us up on [url=https://lostrift.com/discord]Discord[/url] or the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3494520/discussions/]Lost Rift Steam Forums[/url], and we’ll be sure to pick up the torch (no pun intended) and address it as soon as possible. 

[b]Wrapping Up[/b]

We’re incredibly excited to put this game in front of you, starting with our first open Playtest beginning 10 AM Eastern on May 15th, 2025. To be the first to learn how to sign up, join our [url=https://lostrift.com/discord]Discord[/url].

We’re looking forward to you testing our servers and providing feedback to help us build the game alongside you, rather than just behind the scenes. Thank you for reading.

- PCF_Harmonious
[i][b]Lost Rift Product Owner[/b][/i]
